caption: The video captures a backlit agricultural sprinkler already operating in a field, seen through large dark green leaves that remain fixed in the foreground. A vertical post on the right supports the sprinkler head against trees and a bright, hazy sky. From the nozzle, a fan of water is thrown toward the upper left, while scattered droplets and glowing mist spread outward around it. The main jet continuously changes angle, sometimes forming a defined stream to the left and sometimes opening into a brighter, more diffuse forward burst. This sweeping motion keeps the spray pattern active throughout the visible excerpt without any clear start or stop shown. The camera does not move, so the apparent motion belongs to the water, the mist, and the head moving back and forth. Foreground leaves and background trees stay in place while the illuminated spray shifts its direction and brightness through the air.
